description.value: The study tested whether medial orbitofrontal cortex gray matter volume is reduced in abstinent substance-dependent individuals compared with control subjects, and examined associations with decision-making behavior and substance-dependence symptoms.

spans.text: We tested the hypothesis that medial OFC gray matter (GM) volume would be lower in SDI compared with control subjects.

design.value: A cross-sectional between-group voxel-based morphometry study comparing 19 abstinent substance-dependent individuals with 20 control subjects, with ANCOVA, ROI confirmation, and correlations between medial OFC gray matter volume and behavioral and clinical measures.

spans.text: Nineteen SDI and 20 control subjects participated.
Differences in regional GM volume were tested with an analysis of covariance model, co-varying for global GM and age.
